assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All map-derived geometry, area, ratios and scenario locations must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines and facility controls are absent.
assumptions.impact: No statutory development quantum or height is proposed; prototype footprints express program relationships only.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, heritage controls, vegetation, water, utilities, ownership and parcel inventories are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish classifications remain a field-survey workflow rather than parcel decisions.

assumptions.statement: No observed pedestrian, robot, curb, climate, service-demand or behavior calibration dataset is provided.
assumptions.impact: Interactive outputs are synthetic relative comparisons, not forecasts; field observation is required before advice.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, procurement, data controllers and legal responsibility are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Proposed roles and gates are an operating hypothesis for later agreement, not a government commitment.

assumptions.statement: Capital and operating cost baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Phasing is risk- and evidence-gated; it is not an investment schedule or cost estimate.
